title: We don’t Build Properties. We Build Possibilities
summary: Learn how Neoasia Group built scalable HR systems to streamline hiring, improve performance, and support sustainable growth.
body_markdown:
Who we are


## Creating spaces. Growing together.


Alpha Galaxy is a **property development and investment group** . As the business grows, we are strengthening the people practices and systems that support our teams.


## People-focused. Performance-driven.


We aim to give employees the support to develop, the clarity to contribute and the confidence to grow alongside Alpha Galaxy.


## Our People Vision


We believe **sustainable business growth begins with our people** . Our vision is a workplace where employees are treated with fairness and respect, feel valued for their contributions, and have opportunities to learn, grow and take ownership of their work.


Open communication, teamwork and a strong sense of belonging are central to the employer we aim to be.


Our HR transformation


## More clarity. More time for our people.


### Why We Changed


As Alpha Galaxy grows, we recognised the need to move from **fragmented, manual HR processes** towards a more structured, transparent and digitally enabled approach.


### Why brioHR


We chose a **user-friendly, centralised platform** that supports our operational needs and gives employees easier access to their own HR information. Its flexibility and responsive support also informed our choice.


### For Our HR Team


More centralised and consistent records mean **less time consolidating information** and handling routine follow-ups, creating more room for engagement, development and organisational planning.


### For Our Employees


**Attendance, leave and personal HR information** are easier to access through one platform, bringing greater clarity and convenience to everyday HR interactions.


Looking ahead


## Clear goals. Meaningful progress.


Alpha Galaxy is moving towards a more structured, **results-driven approach to performance management** . brioHR will play a crucial role in this transition, helping connect individual contributions with company goals.


01


### Set clear KPIs


Establish clear expectations for every employee.


02


### Review progress


Monitor achievements regularly and identify development needs.


03


### Align contributions


Connect individual performance with the company's goals.


“brioHR is a practical and user-friendly HR platform that brings essential HR processes and employee information together in one place.”


**Sam Lim** , Senior HR Manager, Alpha Galaxy Group
